messages:
maria: Quick ops check — final run checklist for the webinar on Wed: 'Pragmatic LLM Serving — balancing latency & cost'. Rehearsal moved to Fri 11:00am PST. Please ack and upload updated slides by Thu EOD.
aj: Ack. I'll push the updated demo script and a fallback recorded demo link.
sophie: Can we nudge rehearsal to 11:30? Dr Lee (CET) flagged a conflict. Who's MCing?
ryan: I can MC the intro and manage Qs. 11:30 PST is fine for me.
maria: Ok switching to Fri 11:30am PST. Move noted. @dr_lee, can you confirm your availability or prefer pre-recorded intro?
dr_lee: I can't do late EU times. I'll pre-record a 5m intro and share the file by Thu noon.
naomi: Heads up — I'll audit slides for any pricing/SLA claims. Please avoid absolute % improvement statements without sources.
aj: Demo notes: primary is live on Dedicated instance. Backup is a recorded walkthrough: https://s3.redwood-inference/backup-demo.mp4. Quick test command I'll run in rehearsal:
```bash
for i in {1..5}; do curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -X POST -d '{"prompt":"hello","max_tokens":32}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate &
done; wait
```
(remember to scrub keys before screen share)
maria: Lead routing decision: HubSpot form -> sales-inbox webhook -> AE queue. MQL criteria: attended + clicked pricing CTA OR company size >= 50 + requested demo. UTM scheme: utm_campaign=llm_serving_webinar_2026.
ryan: Add Slack alert to #sales-inbox with name, email, company, attended=true, utm. I'll create a mask for PII.
aj: I'll set up the automation (Zap) and run a test payload tonight. Will post results in this thread.
sophie: Run-of-show draft: 0-5m intros, 5-25m tech deep dive, 25-40m live demo, 40-50m audience Q&A, 50-55m closing. Sound good?
sam: Sounds good. For Qs, I'll prepare 5 starter questions and share.
dr_lee: I'll attach the pre-recorded intro link when ready. Also sharing a one-slide backup that explains the demo flow.
naomi: Please drop final deck in /assets/slides/ by Thu 6pm PST. I'll do the content review overnight.
maria: Fallback order if live demo fails: 1) play recorded demo, 2) run through annotated screenshots, 3) switch to synthetic demo on Redwood-sim (no account). Everyone ok with that?
ops-bot: Reminder set — rehearsal Fri 11:30am PST (calendar invite sent).
all: :thumbsup: / 👍 / cheers
sophie: Final asks: headshots + 1-line bios by Thu noon, and confirm any proprietary data used in demos is replaced with synthetic examples.
aj: Noted. I'll remove any PII and add a short script snippet for the synthetic demo endpoint (redwood-sim).
maria: Thanks team — I'll publish the ops checklist (link will be posted here) and send a short checklist email to panelists tomorrow morning. Ping this thread when you upload assets.
